if the raw value for a reference-type property is not a string,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
places:
    somewhere:
        name: Somewhere
persons:
    person-with-errors:
        properties:
            # residence has a "places" reference_type, and so requires a string.
            residence: true
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            residence:
                date: "2023-01-09"
                value: somewhere

-- want-errors --
persons\[person-with-errors\].Properties.residence: value discarded: expected string for "places" reference lookup, got bool
persons\[person-with-errors\].Properties.residence: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
persons\[person-with-errors\].Properties.residence: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    person-with-errors:
        properties: {}
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            residence:
                definition:
                    label: Residence
                    reference_type: places
                entries:
                -   date: "2023-01-09"
                    value: places/somewhere
places:
    somewhere:
        name: Somewhere
        properties: {}
